raw_html: [[Godly Wrath]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Godly Wrath]]:''' This weapon is filled with the power of a wrathful deity. Occasionally, this holy power is unleashed, applying a lasting effect that deals 2 to 8 light damage every two seconds for six seconds. If the effect is reapplied before it wears off, the effect will stack and the duration will reset. The effect can be stacked up to 3 times.
